name: Edit Marketing Copy
summary: Edit existing marketing copy in bounded passes while preserving truth, voice, and intent.
description: Edit existing marketing copy for clarity, specificity, evidence, voice, structure, risk, and action while preserving approved meaning. Use when copy already exists and needs a reviewable improvement rather than a new strategy or unsupported rewrite.
refuses: It does not fabricate proof, customers, outcomes, urgency, scarcity, or guarantees.
It does not erase required disclosures or change commercial terms silently.
It does not overwrite a distinctive voice with generic conversion jargon.
